_comment: Every entry here IS a hole: a step gated on the artefact whose absence is
the defect the step exists to catch. They are listed rather than fixed
because each is owned by an in-flight change on the same subsystem, and
silently allowlisting them would recreate exactly the invisibility this
flow_condition_reachability_check.py FAILs on any hole NOT listed here, and
ALSO FAILs when a listed entry is no longer a hole. A fix must therefore
delete its baseline entry in the same change — the file cannot rot into a
Do not add to this file to make a build green. Add to it only with an
owner, and only when the fix genuinely belongs in another change.

holes.owner: vibe-ic#219 family — NOT covered by that PR's current diff
holes.note: Same shape as DT1 and strictly worse: the condition is ALL-of, so ANY one of the three inputs going missing disarms the step. path_delay_coverage_check ALREADY returns verdict FAIL / rc 1 on an absent coverage JSON, so the checker is correct and only the condition disarms it. The producer (phase3_one_shot_runner.py, DT2 block) records its skips as ephemeral in-memory notes and writes no *_not_run.json, so there is no disclosure artefact to trigger on yet. Fix needs the producer change plus `any_of: true`.

holes.owner: vibe-ic#219 family — NOT covered by that PR's current diff
holes.note: The cascade case: DT3 is gated ALL-of on DT1's and DT2's OUTPUTS, so whenever either upstream ATPG step self-disables, DT3 silently vanishes too. sdd_coverage_check ALREADY returns verdict FAIL / rc 1 on an absent coverage JSON. Like DT2 its producer writes no *_not_run.json record.

holes.owner: unclear — needs an owner decision, do not fix blind
holes.note: UNCLEAR, deliberately not forced into a verdict. The trigger is a file under reports/phase2/gates/, i.e. gate output rather than design evidence, so it is unclear whether the artefact is an INPUT this gate validates (making absence the failure mode) or a prior gate's verdict being re-read (making absence correct scoping). Resolving it requires knowing which component writes professional_tb.json and when, which is not derivable from the flow YAML.
